statusMeaning.ok: Implemented in the shared layer and covered by repository tests; hardware verification is tracked by the catalog status.
statusMeaning.partial: Implemented only for some paths (Android code only, runtime-probed Hamlib capability, beta backend).
statusMeaning.pendiente: pendiente de fuente: no source in the repository, or no adapter yet. Shown disabled in every UI.
